name: Dextrabot
description: Copy-trade top Lighter and Hyperliquid wallets, plus grid and DCA bots.
longDescription:
Dextrabot is a trading automation app for perp DEXs. Users can find and copy-trade wallets on Lighter and Hyperliquid, or run grid and DCA bots on their own account.

Lighter Core and Robinhood Lighter are supported venues: you connect your Lighter account and approve Dextrabot as an integrator, after which the bots place orders on Lighter for you.
